description: Opens a support request to the Buzz Dealer AI team for the connected account: a topic (order, billing, reputation, connection, feedback or other), a short subject, the message and, optionally, the order it is about. Returns the request number and the page where the answer appears; the person also gets the answer by email. Use this when the person wants to ask the team something the other tools cannot answer, report a problem with an order or the account, or send feedback. Show the person the subject and message first and send only what they agreed to. Do not use for questions the other tools answer, such as prices, order status or the balance. Side effects: stores the request, emails the team and the person who asked; spends nothing.

message.description: The question or problem, as the person agreed to send it. Example: "Order 0357fbe4 is two days past its due date. When will it go live?"

order_id.description: Optional: the order it is about (an id from get_order_status). Example: "0357fbe4-4eb9-461c-9582-14266653e9bd"

subject.description: A short subject, in the person's words. Example: "Release still in review after the due date"

topic.description: What it is about: order, billing, reputation, connection, feedback or other. Example: "order"

name: contact_support
title: Contact Buzz Dealer AI support
